mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k in a single month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both housing starts and retail sales finance spending indicates a broad-based recovery in consumer demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1100.0 and RSAFS > 440000.0 fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, it indicates a high-pressure monetary regime that suppresses equity valuations via higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 235.0 are simultaneously true (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) below 440000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 440000.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth indicates labor market deterioration, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% occur simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized (as proxied by GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% annualized (t-test p > 0.05).
